incident_master_data.vessel_type: Container feeder vessel (converted from standard cargo)

spatiotemporal_trajectory.failure_cause: Ballast tank architecture malfunction causing uncontained flooding
spatiotemporal_trajectory.initial_distress_location: 30 to 38 nautical miles southwest of Cochin Port
spatiotemporal_trajectory.proximity_to_shore: 13 to 14.6 nautical miles off the Kerala coast (southwest of Thottappally, Alappuzha district)

oceanographic_metrics.metocean_conditions: Early onset southwest monsoon, highly volatile sea state, strong westerly winds

acquisitions.detection_note: Captured dark patches corresponding to scattered oil spill pixels southwest of Alappuzha
Longer wavelength distinguished between thick emulsions and thinner sheens
Identified massive clusters of drifting containers and debris fields

ecotoxicological_impact.toxicological_threshold_pah: 50 µg/L dissolved load (Induces catastrophic cardiac malformations in fish larvae)
ecotoxicological_impact.chlorophyll_a_depletion: 30 percent collapse within 48 hours due to physical smothering
ecotoxicological_impact.vulnerable_habitat_extent: 516 square kilometers of seagrass meadows in Kerala
ecotoxicological_impact.vulnerable_population: >1.68 lakh marine fishers in Alappuzha district alone

response_recovery_legal.primary_mitigation_chemistry: Oil Spill Dispersants (OSD) applied via Dornier aircraft sorties
response_recovery_legal.fisheries_restriction: 20-nautical-mile radius fishing ban around the wreck
response_recovery_legal.interim_state_relief: ₹1,000 and 6 kilograms of rice per affected fisherman family (GO (Rt) No. 371/2025/DMD)
response_recovery_legal.judicial_collateral: MSC Akikta 2 (Sister vessel arrested and detained)
